What do you want to be when you grow up, Jack?
B
Ha, I used to say an astronaut. Now I have no idea.
A
Seriously? I've known what I want since I was ten.
B
Let me guess. Something with drawing?
A
Yep! I'd love to make cartoons for a living.
B
That's so cool. Are you taking any classes?
A
Just an online course. I practice every night so that I can improve.
B
If I had your talent, I would never stop.
A
It's not talent, it's just practice. You'll find your thing, don't stress.
B
Maybe. For now, I'll just keep trying new stuff.
